Chapter 6163: The High Heaven?

Chapter 6163: The High Heaven?

No emperor or desolate god in Sin could evade this slash. Their head hitting the ground was all but determined.

“Bam!” The blade severed all affinities around Li Qiye, extinguishing them like candles. Now, only he was left.

Unfortunately, his body seemed to be made from the primordial. Its toughness couldn’t be compared to anything else in existence.

This body existed since the start of time and was refined by the primordial. The end of worlds and death of laws occurred around the physique but left no marks. Thus, this slash was hopeless from the start.

“Just like that?!” Jaws dropped to the ground when the slash failed to wound him.

“The technique is fine, just lacks refinement.” Li Qiye said and flicked his finger, easily destroying the slash.

Transcendent staggered backward as his vitality and energy churned chaotically.

Others didn’t dare to comment and felt hopeless. That slash might be second to none in Sin but in Li Qiye’s eyes, it was just child’s play.

They could muster everything they have and not come close to producing anything of that nature. However, it did not affect the opponent.

“Good, one more time!” Transcendent didn’t run and floated upward.

A semi-loop surged upward, forcing emperors to retreat. Dao fruits and anima power accompanied it. Transcendent didn’t hold back and channeled everything he had into the loop.

“Born to be an immortal…” he whispered as the loop rotated around him and turned into a maelstrom. It began to absorb the powers and laws of the world.

The natural forces of Sin along with cultivators’ dao were being sucked into the loop.

“What’s going on?!” Many shouted in horror.

“Buzz.” An azure formed above Transcendent. Lightning bolts descended and engulfed him.

“What is he doing?” Spectators became confused.

“It’s an ultimate move, get back now!” An emperor shouted.

Experts and ancestors regained their wits and went on the run.

The azure was split apart, revealing the high heaven and its might feared by both mortals and cultivators. Emperors and desolate gods shuddered before the incoming tribulations.

Transcendent appeared again, adorned with lightning armors. He seemed to be representing the high heaven, ready to kill its enemies.

“He needs to stop!” A powerful desolate god said, unable to stand straight just like his peers.

“The high heaven is I…” He chanted a mantra and waved his hand, sending this tribulation down against Li Qiye.

He was the master of the elements and the representative of the high heaven - the only way to defeat Li Qiye.

“Can a primal ancestor block this?!” Everyone was astounded by this ultimate technique.

“This is way beyond his cultivation, such incredible dao attainment.” An emperor said.

Some thought he was worthy of his reputation as the greatest genius in Sin - able to conjure such a heaven-defying technique.

“You want to transform into the high heaven?” Li Qiye didn’t bat an eye and said: “Without my permission, just an ant.”

As soon as he finished speaking, he raised his hand and made a fist, preparing to shatter the descending high heaven with a single blow.
